records.title: R_surveillance_hagelloch_hagelloch
records.observation_unit: individu, cas sanitaire ou unite spatiale de sante
records.observed_population: population sanitaire documentee par le package source
records.geographic_context: a preciser depuis la documentation, l'article ou l'etendue spatiale
records.source_description: Data on the 188 cases in the measles outbreak among children in the German city of Hagelloch (near Tübingen) 1861. The data were originally collected by Dr. Albert Pfeilsticker (1863) and augmented and re-analysed by Dr. Heike Oesterle (1992). This dataset is used to illustrate the ‘twinSIR’ model class in ‘vignette("twinSIR")’.
records.formula: event ~ start + stop + atRiskY + AGE + SEX + CL + household + nothousehold
records.formula_used: event ~ start + stop + atRiskY + AGE + SEX + CL + household + nothousehold
records.source_ref: Neal PJ, Roberts GO (2004) Statistical inference and model selection for the 1861 Hagelloch measles epidemic
